footballImplementationGuidance.computationBand: Keep demanding mental arithmetic mostly within 10 or 20 unless a completed lesson explicitly supports more
footballImplementationGuidance.placeValueBand: Two-digit values through 100 are appropriate for reading, decomposition, comparison, ordering, number-line placement, and adding or subtracting 10
footballImplementationGuidance.exposureBand: Treat numbers 101-120 and optional skip-counting lessons as supported or no-stakes exposure until completion is confirmed
footballImplementationGuidance.fieldConstraint: Avoid confusing cross-midfield label arithmetic; use a separate math visualization when football field labels reverse
